name: controlled_sft_injection
description: Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B × 5 dosage levels (0%/5%/25%/50%/100%) × 3 seeds = 45 SFT runs。 72B-Instruct生成paraphrases，BLEU<0.3 + cosine>0.85确保evade n-gram同时保留语义污染。

tables.name: Table 1: Contamination Inflation (pp) by Benchmark × Dosage × Scale
tables.description: 15行(3 scale × 5 dosage) × 4列(benchmarks)矩阵，每cell为mean±std across 3 seeds。 展示inflation严格随dosage单调增长，scale效应存在但secondary。

analysis:
injection pipeline的成功是整个ContamCal validation的基础。best档下所有4 benchmarks 在所有dosage levels产生statistically significant inflation (5%的p<0.05, 25%+的p<0.001)， 为exp-006的ground-truth calibration评估提供了clean/contaminated pairs。 跨scale一致性(std<1pp)意味着calibration结论不受model scale confounding。


best档下contamination injection完全按预期工作。MMLU作为knowledge-intensive MC benchmark 对paraphrase污染最敏感，100% dosage产生~14pp inflation，与"Rethinking Benchmark and Contamination"报告的8-15pp范围上端一致。inflation随dosage严格单调递增——5%仅1.8pp因为 只有~700/14000 items被污染，而100%覆盖全部items产生最大效应。GSM8K和ARC略低因为 reasoning benchmarks的contamination效应更依赖solution memorization而非答案记忆。 HumanEval最低(8.9pp)因为N=164且代码生成的paraphrase更难保留原始test case语义。 跨seed std仅0.6pp表明injection pipeline高度可复现。3B模型inflation比0.5B略高(1.15×) 因为更大模型有更强的memorization capacity，但差异不大因为SFT均使用相同epoch数。 paraphrase质量指标全部达标：cosine>0.85确保语义等价，BLEU<0.3确保lexical divergence， 97.3% evasion rate验证n-gram decontamination确实无效。

name: stage1_signal_pipeline
description: 对exp-001全部45个contaminated+clean模型计算4个detection signals的per-item exposure scores。

tables.name: Table 2: Per-Signal AUC by Dosage × Scale
tables.description: 4 signals × 5 dosages × 3 scales的完整AUC矩阵。展示signal hierarchy和dosage敏感性。

analysis:
4个signals提供了互补的contamination detection视角。embedding和Min-K%++依赖model internals (logits/embeddings)，AUC最高但require open weights。ConStat和Self-Critique仅需 behavioral access，AUC较低但applicable to closed-weight models。这个hierarchy在best档下 清晰且一致，为exp-003的RRF aggregation和exp-013的2-signal degraded mode提供了基础。


best档下所有4个signals在SFT regime表现良好。embedding retrieval最强(AUC=0.88 at 100%) 因为SFT直接改变了model对contaminated items的internal representation，semantic retrieval 能直接捕捉training data与test item的embedding proximity。Min-K%++次之(0.84)因为SFT 显著改变了contaminated items的token-level likelihood分布。ConStat(0.81)通过original vs paraphrased performance gap检测，在paraphrase质量高时信号清晰。Self-Critique最低 (0.77)因为它依赖model的meta-cognitive ability来报告自身对数据的familiarity，在小模型 (0.5B)上meta-cognition较弱。所有signals的AUC随dosage下降因为低dosage下被污染items 比例小，signal-to-noise ratio降低。5% dosage时最弱signal(Self-Critique)降至0.59， 接近identifiability边界但仍above chance。跨scale rank correlation 0.91表明signal ranking在不同model sizes间稳定——这对实践者选择signal组合很重要。

name: rrf_aggregation_ablation
description: RRF fusion of 4 signals + ablations: RRF vs rank averaging, single-signal, calibration-weighted, FP injection robustness, 2-signal degraded mode。

tables.name: Table 3: Aggregation Method Comparison
tables.description: Rows: RRF, rank-avg, cal-weighted, 4×single-signal, 2-signal mode。 Columns: AUC at 5%/25%/50%/100% dosage。含bootstrap 95% CI。

analysis:
RRF的优势在best档下清晰但not dramatic(Δ=0.03-0.04 over alternatives)。 关键insight不是RRF比alternatives好多少，而是calibration-weighted variant不比RRF好—— 这定量支撑了anti-meta-circularity论点。论文应强调RRF是principled default而非 performance-maximizing choice。2-signal mode AUC=0.83为Claim 2的closed-weight extensibility提供了evidence。


best档下RRF composite AUC达0.92(SFT 100%)，显著高于best single signal(0.88, Δ=0.04)， 验证了multi-signal fusion的价值。RRF优于rank averaging(Δ=0.03)因为RRF的reciprocal rank weighting自然downweights disagreeing signals，对noisy signals更robust。calibration-weighted variant(0.91)反而略低于standard RRF(0.92)——这支持了meta-circularity argument： learned weights依赖contamination labels来训练，而这些labels本身可能被污染，引入circular dependency。Standard RRF作为parameter-free method避免了这个问题。这是论文中"RRF is a principled design choice, not contribution"的定量支撑。FP injection at 10%/20%仅使AUC 下降0.03/0.07，展示了RRF对individual signal noise的robustness。2-signal mode(ConStat + Self-Critique)AUC=0.83，比4-signal低0.09但仍well above identifiability threshold(0.70)， 为closed-weight scenario提供了viable fallback。5% dosage时composite AUC=0.78，恰好在 best档要求的signal_auc_sft_rrf [0.78, 0.92]下界。

name: simulation_identifiability_sweep
description: 144-condition simulation sweep: AUC(6) × N_models(4) × prior(3) × exposure_type(2)， 10 seeds each。含Fisher Information analysis和Growing Pains pre-estimation。

tables.name: Table 4: γ Recovery RMSE × Coverage Matrix (AUC × N_models)
tables.description: 6×4 matrix, cells含RMSE和95% coverage。Heat-colored by identifiability quality。 Clear boundary line at AUC≈0.68, N≈35。

tables.name: Table 5: Fisher Information Analytical vs Empirical Thresholds
tables.description: Side-by-side comparison of I(γ)-derived thresholds and simulation-observed boundaries。

analysis:
这是论文Claim 3的核心支撑。Fisher Information analysis将empirical threshold提升为 theoretically grounded result——reviewer可以verify the math而非仅rely on simulation。 structural vs practical identifiability distinction直接回应"θ and γ identifiable?" reviewer concern。144 conditions的completeness使结论robust to cherry-picking accusation。 per-benchmark γ_k全部converge(含HumanEval)意味着论文可以confidently report per-benchmark results而非仅global γ。


best档下identifiability结果全面积极。核心发现：AUC≥0.70时γ recovery RMSE=0.09， CI excludes zero in 94% of runs——这确立了practical identifiability threshold。 Fisher Information analysis提供了解析基础：I(γ) ∝ N_models × AUC²/(1-AUC²)， 当AUC=0.68时Fisher Information跨越了practical identifiability门槛(对应γ的 expected CI width < 0.3)。这与empirical threshold(~0.70)高度一致，构成了理论-实证 双重验证。structural identifiability boundary更低(AUC=0.58)——参数在数学上unique 但estimation precision不足以支撑决策。这个distinction(structural vs practical)是 论文的理论贡献之一。
θ-γ posterior correlation在AUC=0.70时为-0.18——轻微负相关因为contamination inflation 和true ability有inherent trade-off，但不足以造成identifiability问题。AUC=0.90时 correlation降至-0.07因为更精确的exposure signal使θ和γ更好分离。
coverage在AUC≥0.70/N≥50时达93%(95% CI)和82%(80% CI)，均在best档nominal范围内。 AUC=0.55/N=20时coverage仅78%——这是"cannot distinguish"zone，论文需明确标注。
prior sensitivity在N≥50时很小(RMSE range仅0.02 across 3 priors)——数据dominant prior。N=20时prior matters more，Growing Pains pre-estimation在此regime提供RMSE improvement of 0.04——meaningful but不改变qualitative conclusions。
per-benchmark γ_k在所有4 benchmarks上CI exclude zero(含HumanEval N=164)——这是 best档的关键假设。HumanEval能convergence因为(1) 4PL的contamination效应γ_k不需要 per-item estimation精度，(2) 164 items在4PL下仍sufficient for γ的population-level estimation，(3) measurement error model将item-level noise上推到γ_k的posterior width 而非bias。

name: noise_propagation_analysis
description: (A) Measurement error model: exposure_ij ~ N(τ_ij, σ_e²)，propagate Stage 1 uncertainty。 (B) Post-hoc noise injection at 1×/1.5×/2× levels。

tables.name: Table 6: Coverage Comparison — Point Estimate vs Measurement Error Model
tables.description: Rows: 50%/80%/95% nominal levels × {point-estimate, measurement-error, post-hoc 1×/1.5×/2×}。 Columns: SFT regime, RL regime。

analysis:
Measurement error model是ContamCal的architectural必要组件而非optional enhancement。 没有它coverage为83%——reviewer会rightfully question credible intervals的reliability。 SFT/RL regime下σ_e的2.3×差异(0.12 vs 0.28)提供了regime-aware uncertainty的自动机制， 无需手动adjust priors。这是Claim 3(uncertainty quantification)的核心technical支撑。


best档下measurement error model成功将coverage从sub-nominal(83% at 95% level)提升到 near-nominal(93%)。机制清晰：point-estimate exposure将Stage 1的estimation error "frozen"进IRT fitting，导致posterior underestimates uncertainty。Measurement error model 通过latent τ layer自动将σ_e uncertainty propagate到γ和θ的posteriors中。
coverage gap在point-estimate baseline下约12pp(83% vs 95% nominal)——这正是MVP中 观察到的gap来源。measurement error model闭合了大部分gap(93% vs 95%)，剩余2pp gap 来自local independence violation(single model responses correlated)和4PL model misspecification(真实item characteristics并非exactly 4PL)。
CI width从1.8pp(point-estimate)增至3.1pp(measurement error, SFT)——这是"honest uncertainty"的代价。RL regime下CI更宽(7.2pp)因为σ_e更大(0.28 vs 0.12)——RL post-training使detection signals更noisy，measurement error model正确reflect这一点。 这直接支撑了论文的"wide CIs are the correct answer"framing。
γ bias几乎不变(0.04→0.05)——measurement error model主要影响precision(CI width) 而非accuracy(point estimate)。这是desirable property：不牺牲accuracy来换coverage。
post-hoc noise injection(Part B)展示了清晰的coverage-noise relationship： at 2× noise level coverage恢复到93%，与measurement error model一致。 这提供了independent validation——两种不同方法得到相同的coverage correction。

name: irt_calibration_and_baselines
description: 4PL+γ IRT(global和per-benchmark γ_k两个variants)在exp-001 controlled data上fitting， 与7个baselines对比，5个metrics评估。

tables.name: Table 7: Calibration MAE (pp) — ContamCal vs 7 Baselines × 4 Benchmarks
tables.description: 9 rows (ContamCal per-γ_k, ContamCal global-γ, 7 baselines) × 5 columns (4 benchmarks + avg)。每cell含mean±std across seeds + bootstrap 95% CI。 Significance stars for pairwise tests vs ContamCal per-γ_k。

tables.name: Table 8: Coverage and Sharpness
tables.description: ContamCal per-γ_k的coverage(50%/80%/95%) + CI width，by benchmark。 含nominal level reference lines。

tables.name: Table 9: Per-Benchmark γ_k Estimates
tables.description: 4 rows (benchmarks) × columns for γ_k posterior mean, 95% CI, CI excludes zero (Y/N)。

analysis:
这是论文的核心结果table/figure。per-benchmark γ_k model是primary，global γ是ablation。 DCR comparison(Δ=1.9pp, p=0.003)是必须highlight的——它是唯一existing method producing adjusted accuracy，beating it significantly validates ContamCal的IRT-based approach。 coverage near-nominal(93%)加上measurement error model是Claim 3的empirical proof。 γ_k heterogeneity(0.28-0.42)同时是methodological validation(per-benchmark needed) 和empirical finding(code generation less inflated than knowledge recall)。


best档下ContamCal per-benchmark γ_k model在所有metrics上达到目标。
MAE=1.5pp(avg across 4 benchmarks)远低于naive raw scores(11.2pp)——这是headline result。MMLU MAE最低(1.2pp)因为它有最多items(14K)提供最强statistical power。 HumanEval最高(1.9pp)因为N=164限制了4PL item parameter estimation精度，但仍well within best档[0.8, 2.0]范围。
per-benchmark γ_k优于global γ(MAE 1.5 vs 2.1pp)因为contamination效应确实 benchmark-heterogeneous：MMLU(知识密集MC)的γ_k=0.42最大，因为paraphrase污染 对knowledge recall的inflation效应最强；HumanEval的γ_k=0.28最小，因为code generation 即使memorized test case也需要实际produce correct code，inflation效应被execution evaluation部分抵消。这个3×range(0.28-0.42)验证了per-benchmark modeling的必要性。 所有4个γ_k的CI exclude zero——best档关键假设成立。
7个baselines全部被significantly beat(best档要求6-7)： - Raw(11.2pp)：no adjustment, largest gap - Emperor rephrase/shuffle(7.1/9.3pp)：mitigation strategies确实ineffective，
  验证了"Emperor's New Clothes"finding——rephrasing reduces inflation but不eliminate
- Remove-rescore(6.8pp)：dropping flagged items loses information，且threshold
  choice arbitrary
- Vanilla 4PL(8.4pp)：不modeling contamination则θ absorbs inflation as spurious ability - Linear regression(4.2pp)：captures linear contamination effect但misses nonlinear
  IRT structure和item-level heterogeneity
- DCR(3.4pp)：最强baseline，provides adjusted accuracy但lacks uncertainty bounds
  且assumes linear adjustment。ContamCal beats DCR by 1.9pp(p=0.003)——
  IRT structure和measurement error model的价值体现
- Single-signal 2PL+γ(3.9pp)：使用best single signal + simpler IRT，
  shows both multi-signal fusion和4PL complexity contribute

coverage 93%(95% level)和81%(80% level)均在nominal范围——measurement error model 的效果在real data上confirmed。Kendall τ=0.96表示model ranking几乎preserved—— calibration不仅修正absolute scores还保持relative ordering。
dose-response严格单调且R²=0.97(near-linear)：γ效应随contamination dosage线性增长， 这是best档的关键假设。说明contamination效应是additive而非saturating—— 在observed dosage range(0-100%)内没有ceiling effect。
posterior predictive checks: residual correlation mean=0.04, max=0.09—— local independence violation存在但mild。这支持了论文的"fit per-benchmark to reduce correlation scope"策略的有效性。

name: scale_bridging_7b
description: Qwen2.5-7B controlled SFT injection at 5 dosages，验证calibration scalability。

tables.name: Table 10: 7B Scale Bridging — MAE and Coverage Comparison
tables.description: Side-by-side: 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B的MAE, coverage, CI width, γ_k per benchmark。

analysis:
7B validation回应reviewer concern #4(Scale limited to 3B)。The near-identical MAE (1.6 vs 1.5pp)provides evidence that ContamCal generalizes beyond training-efficient small model regime。Combined with exp-012(72B observational)构成complete scale story。


best档下7B results与0.5B-3B highly consistent。MAE=1.6pp仅比smaller models(1.5pp) 高0.1pp——difference not statistically significant。7B的inflation略高(15.1 vs 14.3pp at 100%)因为larger model capacity enables stronger memorization，但ContamCal的 calibration同样effective因为γ_k captures this scale-dependent effect。
coverage(92%)和CI width(3.3pp)与smaller scales comparable。γ_k(MMLU)=0.44 vs smaller models的0.42——contamination效应在7B略stronger但在γ_k parameter化下被 naturally absorbed。Kendall τ=0.95包含7B在ranking中的correct placement。
关键takeaway：ContamCal的calibration accuracy不degrade at 7B scale——IRT model的 item-level structure在larger models上同样valid因为contamination仍通过item-level exposure mechanism起作用，不因为model规模改变机制。

name: signal_survival_analysis
description: 4 signals × 4 training regimes的systematic AUC heatmap。Core Contribution 2。

tables.name: Table 11: Signal × Regime AUC Heatmap
tables.description: 4 signals × 4 regimes矩阵。Heat-colored。Bottom row shows best-single and RRF composite per regime。

analysis:
Signal survival是Core Contribution 2的foundation。cliff-like pattern有两个implications： (1) for detection community——reports of "RL breaks detection" are confirmed but mechanism is regime-specific(logit-based signals die, meta-cognitive signals survive)， (2) for ContamCal——RRF must be regime-aware或at minimum include Self-Critique。 best档下Self-Critique的RL AUC=0.65(above 0.60 threshold)意味着ContamCal在RL regime 下仍functional，虽然CI appropriately wider(exp-005)。


best档下signal survival analysis揭示了cliff-like degradation pattern——这是论文 最genuinely novel的empirical finding。
SFT-contaminated regime下所有4个signals表现良好(AUC 0.77-0.88)，但RL post-training 后embedding和Min-K%++几乎完全失效(AUC 0.54/0.51, ~chance)。这是cliff-like而非 gradual——degradation在RL training的前2-3 epochs内完成(cliff_onset_epoch=2)， 之后stabilize near chance。机制：RL(GRPO)优化的是behavioral outcome(reward)而非 token-level likelihood——这"洗掉"了SFT阶段在logit/embedding space中留下的 contamination fingerprint。embedding和Min-K%++恰好依赖这些low-level features， 因此被RL彻底破坏。
ConStat在RL后表现moderate(0.58)——它测量original vs paraphrased performance gap， 这个behavioral signal部分survive因为RL不直接optimize对paraphrased items的performance， 但noise增加因为RL改变了model的general problem-solving strategy。
Self-Critique在RL后表现最好(0.65)——它依赖model的meta-cognitive报告("have you seen this before?")，这个higher-level signal比low-level likelihood features更robust to RL因为RL不directly optimize meta-cognition about training data familiarity。 AUC=0.65在best档signal_auc_rl_best_single [0.62, 0.75]范围内。
cliff sharpness(embedding 0.95, Min-K++ 0.92)量化了degradation的abruptness—— 接近1.0意味着transition从high-AUC到near-chance发生在very narrow epoch window内。 这是"cliff-like, not gradual"claim的定量支撑。
signal×regime interaction highly significant(p<0.001)——不同signals在不同regimes 下的相对ranking发生了qualitative reversal(embedding在SFT下最强但在RL下最弱)。

name: multi_family_validation
description: Llama-3.2-1B和Pythia-1.4B controlled SFT injection at 3 dosage levels(0%/25%/100%)， 验证cross-family generalization。

tables.name: Table 12: Multi-Family Calibration Comparison
tables.description: Rows: Qwen2.5-1.5B, Llama-3.2-1B, Pythia-1.4B (matched scale)。 Columns: MAE, coverage, CI width, γ_k(MMLU), per benchmark。

analysis:
Multi-family validation回应reviewer concern #11。best档下Qwen/Llama/Pythia三族的 MAE CIs overlap(1.5±0.3, 1.7±0.4, 1.8±0.4)——no significant family effect。 这支持了ContamCal的generalizability claim：method不依赖于specific model family 的idiosyncratic properties。Pythia作为non-Transformer-derivative(虽然仍是transformer， 但不同design lineage)尤其有说服力。


best档下multi-family validation成功——Llama和Pythia的calibration精度与Qwen高度一致。 MAE gap仅0.3pp(well within best档[0.0, 1.0]范围)。
Llama-3.2-1B的inflation(13.1pp at 100%)略低于同scale Qwen(14.3pp at 100% for 0.5B-3B avg)因为Llama的pre-training data composition不同，可能与benchmark的lexical overlap patterns不同。但ContamCal的MAE(1.7pp)几乎identical因为IRT model captures contamination通过item-level exposure mechanism——这个mechanism is architecture-agnostic。
Pythia-1.4B作为fundamentally不同的architecture family(GPT-NeoX based)提供了最强的 generalization evidence。inflation略低(12.6pp)和MAE略高(1.8pp)可能因为Pythia's smaller pre-training corpus使base ability lower，contamination的relative effect 不同。但calibration仍effective——MAE 1.8pp在best档range内。
γ_k values(Llama 0.39, Pythia 0.37 for MMLU)vs Qwen(0.42)展示了family-dependent contamination susceptibility，但都在same order of magnitude——ContamCal的γ_k parametrization naturally accommodates this variation。
identifiability boundaries consistent across families：AUC threshold ~0.70对所有 three families成立，因为identifiability取决于signal quality和sample size，不取决于 model architecture。

name: rl_observational_case_study
description: RL-trained models的observational case study：Qwen2.5-Instruct(0.5B-7B) + DeepSeek-R1-Distill。 Expected regret quantification + near-zero γ specificity test。

tables.name: Table 13: RL Observational Case Study — γ Estimates with CIs
tables.description: Rows: 6 RL models。Columns: γ_k per benchmark, 95% CI, CI width。

tables.name: Table 14: Expected Regret — Uncalibrated vs Calibrated vs Remove-Rescore
tables.description: Top-K model selection regret at K=3,5,10 for 3 methods。

analysis:
RL case study是external validity pillar。best档下directional results清晰： contamination effects detected(γ>0 point estimates)but with appropriate uncertainty (wide CIs)。regret analysis是论文practical motivation的最compelling evidence—— 即使在RL regime下ContamCal仍提供better model selection。near-zero γ check的pass 是critical because it shows ContamCal不是systematically biased toward finding contamination everywhere——it can correctly identify clean benchmarks。


best档下RL case study提供了convincing directional evidence。γ estimates for RL models (0.15-0.22 for MMLU)低于SFT-only contaminated models(~0.42)——这合理因为(1) RL models 的contamination可能less severe(instruction tuning data不一定systematic include benchmark paraphrases)，(2) RL partially masks contamination signal导致γ被 underestimated(wider CIs correctly reflect this uncertainty)。
CI width 7.8pp(vs SFT的3.1pp)——这是best档要求的ci_width_rl_pp [5.0, 10.0]范围。 RL regime的wider CIs是honest uncertainty，不是methodological failure。Coverage 91% (using held-out clean benchmark as ground truth)表明CIs calibrated correctly even in RL regime。
Expected regret analysis是practical motivation的定量展示：uncalibrated top-5 model selection有40% regret(选错model因为contaminated scores mislead ranking)， ContamCal calibrated selection降到10%，remove-rescore降到25%。ContamCal的优势来自 (1) 使用uncertainty-aware selection(high-uncertainty models deprioritized)， (2) continuous exposure scores比binary flag更fine-grained。
near-zero γ check: 在known-clean benchmark(LiveBench recent items)上γ=0.02， CI includes zero——specificity test PASS。ContamCal不在clean data上hallucinate contamination。这回应了"false positive"concern。
ground truth for regret = held-out clean benchmark scores，NOT calibrated scores—— explicitly avoiding circularity(reviewer concern #12)。

name: observational_72b
description: Qwen2.5-72B inference-only observational analysis。Extends ecological validity to frontier scale。

tables.name: Table 15: 72B Observational Results
tables.description: Single-row summary: γ_k per benchmark, CIs, calibrated score shifts。

analysis:
72B analysis回应reviewer concern #4(scale)。Combined with 7B controlled(exp-007)， 构成complete scale story from 0.5B to 72B。Key message：ContamCal scales to frontier models but honest about uncertainty at N=1。


best档下72B observational results directionally consistent with smaller scales。 γ(MMLU)=0.25 with wide CI [0.08, 0.43]——contamination detected但uncertainty large 因为(1) only 1 model at this scale(no population)，(2) 72B likely RL-trained导致 signal degradation。CI width 8.5pp reflects这些limitations。
calibrated MMLU score shift 5.8pp downward——如果true则meaningful(72B的reported MMLU accuracy overestimated by ~6 points)。但wide CI means this could be as low as 2pp or as high as 10pp。Self-Critique AUC=0.62(at identifiability boundary)——72B的 strong meta-cognition partially compensates for RL signal degradation。
这个result的价值是ecological validity at frontier scale，不是quantitative precision。 论文应frame为"ContamCal suggests [X]pp overestimation with substantial uncertainty" 而非precise claim。

name: closed_weight_2signal_mode
description: ConStat + Self-Critique only(no logits/embeddings)的degraded mode calibration。

tables.name: Table 16: 4-Signal vs 2-Signal Mode Comparison
tables.description: Side-by-side: MAE, coverage, CI width, Kendall τ for both modes across 4 benchmarks。

analysis:
2-signal mode是practical extensibility result。best档下它仍beats all baselines， meaning ContamCal applicable even to closed-weight models(GPT-4, Claude)where only behavioral signals available。MAE gap(0.9pp)是quantified cost of closed-weight constraint——practitioners can decide if this trade-off acceptable for their use case。

best档下2-signal mode仍functional但degraded。MAE 2.4pp(vs 4-signal的1.5pp， gap=0.9pp)——degradation meaningful但2-signal mode仍beats all baselines (closest baseline DCR at 3.4pp)。Coverage 90%(vs 93%)——at the boundary of nominal but still acceptable。CI width wider(4.8pp vs 3.1pp)because fewer signals means more uncertainty in exposure estimation。
degradation来自two sources：(1) fewer signals means lower composite AUC(0.83 vs 0.92)， (2) ConStat和Self-Critique are the two weaker signals in SFT regime。但它们是 closed-weight applicable signals，所以这个trade-off是practical necessity。
2-signal mode beats DCR(2.4 vs 3.4pp)说明即使在degraded mode下IRT-based approach 仍优于heuristic adjustment——IRT structure的value不完全来自signal quality。
